chapter: Vic Gaspard and the Lyric Theatre
title: Jack Teagarden and early trombone solos
summary: Summers claims he and Jack Teagarden, who lived in New Orleans and played the Palace Theatre, were first to play trombone solos, ahead of Tommy Dawson; they studied with Gaspard together.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
